summary: Implemented the thread lab in /app/thread: (1) user/uthread.c thread_create/thread_schedule/thread_yield with proper register save/restore via uthread_switch.S — verified in QEMU that thread_a/b/c all run to completion with no missing keys; (2) notxv6/ph.c uses per-bucket mutexes (pthread_mutex_init per bucket) so concurrent puts to different buckets run in parallel — verified 0 keys missing for 1 and 2 threads and ~1.76x puts/second speedup (11054 -> 19455 puts/s); (3) notxv6/barrier.c barrier() implemented with mutex + condition variable and round tracking — verified OK for 1, 2, and 4 threads. answers-thread.txt and time.txt present. Limitation: ph_fast speedup measured at ~1.76x on this machine, above the 1.25x requirement but hardware-dependent.
